lines.trans: This morning their official Weibo account also posted a statement.
The statement says last night was an accident.
Yet between the lines it still hints Xingtian failed to look after their artist.
In such a short time, this is the most we could secure.
The people from the network have arrived.
They want us to join them in the conference room right away.
It is so early that breakfast shops have not even opened yet.
The moment trouble broke out last night, they must have met overnight.
They worked out a plan and came first thing this morning to demand answers.
